page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.4xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 architecture, utilizing the Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. Local storage is not bundled with this instance, requiring external block storage attachment, and network performance is rated at a baseline bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a clear contrast between single-core and multi-core performance. Single-core execution is relatively weak, with stress-ng single-core and Geekbench single-core scores falling into the bottom 25% and 10% categories respectively. Single-threaded compression tasks, such as gzip and bzip3, also show poor performance. However, the instance leverages its 16 dedicated cores to achieve average multi-core performance. Multi-threaded benchmarks, including Geekbench multi-core, Passmark CPU, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, consistently rank in the middle 50% tier. Memory bandwidth for both read and write operations also performs at an average level.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.sn2ne.4xlarge offers a stable, dedicated resource profile suitable for workloads that can parallelize tasks to overcome single-core limitations. It is well-suited for multi-threaded applications, static web serving, software compilation, and Redis database operations, which perform at average tier speeds. It is less optimal for single-threaded processing or demanding large-scale language model inference, where its 7B model prompt processing and text generation speeds are weak.
